1.web: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.
1.asv: Now concerning spiritualgifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.

2.web: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.
2.asv: Ye know that when ye were Gentiles ye were led away unto those dumb idols, howsoever ye might be led.

3.web: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.
3.asv: Wherefore I make known unto you, that no man speaking in the Spirit of God saith, Jesus is anathema; and no man can say, Jesus is Lord, but in the Holy Spirit.

4.web: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.
4.asv: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.

5.web: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.
5.asv: And there are diversities of ministrations, and the same Lord.

6.web: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God, who works all things in all.
6.asv: And there are diversities of workings, but the same God, who worketh all things in all.

7.web: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.
7.asv: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit to profit withal.

8.web: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge, according to the same Spirit;
8.asv: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom; and to another the word of knowledge, according to the same Spirit:

9.web: to another faith, by the same Spirit; and to another gifts of healings, by the same Spirit;
9.asv: to another faith, in the same Spirit; and to another gifts of healings, in the one Spirit;

10.web: and to another workings of miracles; and to another prophecy; and to another discerning of spirits; to another different kinds of languages; and to another the interpretation of languages.
10.asv: and to another workings of miracles; and to another prophecy; and to another discernings of spirits: to another divers kinds of tongues; and to another the interpretation of tongues:

11.web: But the one and the same Spirit works all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.
11.asv: but all these worketh the one and the same Spirit, dividing to each one severally even as he will.

12.web: For as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.
12.asv: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

13.web: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.
13.asv: For in one Spirit were we all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all made to drink of one Spirit.

14.web: For the body is not one member, but many.
14.asv: For the body is not one member, but many.

15.web: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.
15.asv: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; it is not therefore not of the body.

16.web: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.
16.asv: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; it is not therefore not of the body.

17.web: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?
17.asv: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?

18.web: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.
18.asv: But now hath God set the members each one of them in the body, even as it pleased him.

19.web: If they were all one member, where would the body be?
19.asv: And if they were all one member, where were the body?

20.web: But now they are many members, but one body.
20.asv: But now they are many members, but one body.

21.web: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
21.asv: And the eye cannot say to the hand, I have no need of thee: or again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

22.web: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.
22.asv: Nay, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be more feeble are necessary:

23.web: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant propriety;
23.asv: and those parts of the body, which we think to be less honorable, upon these we bestow more abundant honor; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness;

24.web: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,
24.asv: whereas our comely parts have no need: but God tempered the body together, giving more abundant honor to that part which lacked;

25.web: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.
25.asv: that there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.

26.web: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. Or when one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
26.asv: And whether one member suffereth, all the members suffer with it; or one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

27.web: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
27.asv: Now ye are the body of Christ, and severally members thereof.

28.web: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.
28.asv: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondly prophets, thirdly teachers, then miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, divers kinds of tongues.

29.web: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?
29.asv: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?

30.web: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?
30.asv: have all gifts of healings? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?

31.web: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
31.asv: But desire earnestly the greater gifts. And moreover a most excellent way show I unto you.
